_note: The Execution versus Ambition universe. Megawatts only, because megawatts are the one unit on which data centre operators are actually comparable. Server makers, systems integrators and picks and shovels names sit in the watchlist on their own metrics and are deliberately absent from the plot: putting an order book and a megawatt on the same axes would invent a comparability that does not exist.
_ambitionWarning: Announced capacity is an ambition, not a result. Every announced figure here is a company statement about the future. Keeping that line bright is the point of the exhibit.

operators.note: Real estate to data centre pivot. 28 MW of IT load across Manesar and Panchkula against a 307 MW target by Fiscal 2032 at roughly 2.1 billion dollars of capex. Only 8 MW had been completely handed over, the rest still in the handover process. Operational capacity is not the same as handed over capacity, and this is the clearest instance of that gap in the universe.
